name: North Salem Day Camp at Mt. Lakes
operator_name: Town of North Salem Recreation Department
description_short: Six week town day camp at Mountain Lakes Park in North Salem for children from age 4 (entering kindergarten or their last preschool year) through 7th grade, with daily swimming, lake boating for older campers, archery, hiking, sports, arts and music. Campers ride a bus from North Salem Middle/High School.
swim_waterfront_notes: Daily swim in a large in-ground pool with certified lifeguards and Water Safety Instructors; campers from 4th grade boat on Hemlock Lake in canoes, kayaks, rowboats and paddleboats. The preschool group swims in the big pool a few times a week.
refund_policy_summary: Requests before June 1 are refunded in full less a $20 processing fee and card convenience fees; from June 1 to the first day, 75% of tuition less those fees; none after camp starts except for moves, extended illness or injury, or other approved reasons.
notes: Residents and the North Salem school district registered from March 19, 2026, non-residents from March 20. $60 early bird discount if paid in full before April 1; a $75 late fee per session after May 15. Drop off 8:35 to 8:55 am and pick up 3:10 to 3:20 pm at North Salem Middle/High School, 230 June Road; busing is mandatory. Counselor in Training program for teens entering 8th grade to age 15.
